personality_one_liner: A high-performance, dark-neon automotive command center built for instant diagnostics and precise technical readouts.

spacing.rule: Generous margin for structural layout, dense padding within data cards for scanability. Use 16px safe-area offsets.

do's: Use solid dark surfaces separated by hairlines (divider) to maintain high readability and utility feel.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism on data-heavy dashboard screens; clarity and OLED-friendly contrast is priority.

screens.name: Connect
screens.purpose: Searches for and connects to the OBD-II device via Bluetooth.

states.loading: Connecting... with a pulsating neon blue ring animation.
states.empty: No devices found within range. Illustration of OBD plug + retry.
states.error: Connection failed. Make sure device is plugged in and ignition is ON.

screens.layout: Hero layout with the abstract neon blue light background (Layer 1). A central radar/scanning animation. Bottom sheet overlay displaying discovered BLE devices in a list row format with connection state (Blue = Connectable). Large 'Connect' sticky bottom button.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Displays vital vehicle info (VIN, Make, Year, Mileage) and acts as the launchpad for car scanning.

states.loading: Skeleton rows for car data fetching.
states.empty: N/A - Dashboard only shows after successful connection.
states.error: Error reading vehicle ECU. Retry button.

screens.layout: Profile-style header featuring a dark sports car image with a vertical gradient-to-dark scrim. Tabular grid layout below for Vehicle details (VIN, Model, Year). Large sticky CTA pinned at the bottom: 'Scan Car' (brandPrimary background).

screens.name: FaultCodes
screens.purpose: Displays the result of the diagnostic scan, listing DTCs grouped by system or a clean bill of health.

states.loading: Simulated scanning progress bar with scanning metrics (Checking Engine... Checking ABS...).
states.empty: No Errors state: Large success checkmark icon, 'All Systems Go' text, neon green accents.
states.error: Failed to read codes. Retry button.

screens.layout: Segmented list view. Each row represents a fault code (e.g., P0300) with bold alphanumeric text and a descriptive subtext. Group tags (Engine, Transmission, Lights) use distinct colored chips (e.g., engine = orange, transmission = purple). Sticky bottom CTA 'Send check result' over a solid surface background.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Lists previously saved car check results from the database.

states.empty: No past scans. Subtitle: 'Your diagnostic history will appear here.'
states.error: Failed to load history from database.

screens.layout: Scrollable list of cards. Each card shows Date, Vehicle Make/Model, and number of faults found (badge). Use divider lines between list rows instead of full cards to maintain utility feel.

hero_bg.alt: Abstract neon blue light streaks on black background

car_profile.alt: Modern sports car taillights on dark background

dashboard_empty.alt: Analog tachometer glowing in the dark

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility DARK guidelines. Rely on sharp contrast and deep blacks (#050505 base, #121214 cards). Do not introduce any white backgrounds or light theme modes.
The primary brand color is Neon Cyan (#00E5FF) representing the 'radacini' identity as requested. Use this for main active states, scan animations, and the primary Connect/Scan buttons.
Implement the 'Connect' screen as a hero view using the `hero_bg` image with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim to ensure text remains readable.

In the FaultCodes list, use the specific color tokens defined in the guidelines for grouping categories (engine=orange, transmission=purple, lights=yellow, brakes=red) inside small rounded tags or badges.
Ensure 'Send check result' and 'Scan Car' buttons are sticky at the bottom using a SafeAreaView / bottom padding approach with a solid surface background so scrolling content goes neatly underneath.
The typography should feel highly technical. Use Rajdhani for all large numeric metrics, error codes (e.g., P0300), and main headers. Use IBM Plex Sans for body and descriptions.
Always wrap hero/cover images (like `car_profile`) with an expo-linear-gradient scrim (transparent to surface color) to ensure any overlaid white text is readable.
Avoid glassmorphism. Use solid colors and simple 1px borders (`border` token) for section dividers to keep the utility UI sharp and OLED-friendly.
